how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-redridge-mountains-02-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:34:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ of Lakeshire wants you to kill ⟦E2⟧. Bring her his tusk as proof.
rows.quest:34:details:0: Once again my garden was trampled and pillaged. And I know the brute who is doing it. It's that forsaken boar, the one ⟦E3⟧ has taken to calling ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:34:details:1: I won't be able to re-plant the daffodils until next season now. Ruined! All ruined by that one menacing boar. Put an end to that pest! Show me his tusk and I'd be happy to reward you. He seems to spend his time foraging in the field southwest of Lakeshire but occasionally he roams over here and into my garden.
rows.quest:34:progress:0: Is ⟦E2⟧ still at it or were you able to rid Lakeshire of the pest once and for all?
rows.quest:34:completion:0: Finally the menace is laid to rest! Thank you, ⟦1⟧, you have done me a great service. The garden shall be in full bloom this season!
rows.quest:19:details:0: Blackrock Outrunners and Renegades are running ambushes between here and Stonewatch Keep. The leader of the Outrunners is an orc named ⟦E5⟧--we want this orc. Bring me the head of ⟦E5⟧!
rows.quest:19:progress:0: Orc pressure from Blackrock is still tense. But have you at least rid us of ⟦E5⟧?
rows.quest:19:completion:0: ⟦E5⟧ was a vicious, crafty orc. Well done - I'm sure he didn't go down easy. Here is your reward, ⟦2⟧.
rows.quest:126:details:0: ⟦3⟧, the gnolls are still out there. I can hear their baying as they hunt in the hills above Lakeshire. And one cry is louder than the rest - ⟦E9⟧, their leader.
rows.quest:126:details:1: Kill ⟦E9⟧ and send his pack scattering! Bring me his paw as proof.
rows.quest:126:details:2: And be careful, this gnoll is their leader for a reason. He is no Mongrel...
rows.quest:126:progress:0: ⟦E9⟧ is a dangerous creature, ⟦4⟧. If you're not ready for him, I understand.
rows.quest:126:completion:0: Again, thank you for your help. The ⟦E10⟧ army is so busy dealing with the orcs, they don't have the troops to protect Redridge from local threats like the gnolls.
rows.quest:128:obj:0: Kill 15 Blackrock Champions and ⟦E11⟧ in Lakeshire will reward you.
rows.quest:128:details:0: The Blackrock Clan must be destroyed. The Enemy has invaded our lands. These mountains fall under the sovereign right of the King of ⟦E10⟧. Our sources tell us that the leaders of each unit within the Clan are known as Champions. You'll find them in their encampment to the north, just west of the road to the ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:128:details:1: ⟦E14⟧ wants these foul brutes dead. Slay 15 Blackrock Champions and return to me.
rows.quest:128:progress:0: Return once you have slain 15 Blackrock Champions.
rows.quest:128:completion:0: I see you have fought valiantly against the Blackrock Clan, ⟦5⟧. Your service to our township is great indeed.
rows.quest:219:obj:0: Protect ⟦E15⟧ on the journey back to Redridge.
rows.quest:219:details:2: The last thing I remember these foul Orcs overpowered our regiment. Most the men were killed. I took a strong blow to the head and everything went black. Now I am held captive in this cave. Help me, I am hurt badly.
rows.quest:219:details:3: I'll need help getting back to town... please... you're my last hope...
rows.quest:219:completion:0: You have served the Kingdom well, ⟦6⟧. Thank you for assisting ⟦E15⟧ with his escape from those dreaded Blackrock Orcs. You shall be rewarded for your brave acts this day.
rows.quest:95999:title: ⟦E18⟧: Incinerator Gar'im
rows.quest:169:obj:0: Kill ⟦E20⟧ and bring his head to ⟦E14⟧ in Lakeshire for the reward.
rows.quest:169:details:0: ⟦E21⟧ ⟦E20⟧, Leader of the Blackrock attacks on Stonewatch Keep and raids against the township of Lakeshire.
rows.quest:169:details:1: ⟦E20⟧ is extremely dangerous. He is reportedly holed up in the recently conquered keep plotting the Blackrock clan's further crimes against humanity. The orc infestation must be quelled at all costs. A gracious reward will be given to whatever brave soul can deliver the head of ⟦E20⟧ to ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:169:completion:0: Fantastic work, ⟦8⟧! ⟦E20⟧ led those brutes into battle, killing many innocent humans. Vindication is ours. This is the first step in reclaiming the keep for the kingdom of ⟦E10⟧!
rows.quest:180:obj:0: Kill ⟦E23⟧ and return to ⟦E14⟧ in Lakeshire with his paw.
rows.quest:180:details:1: Known leader of the ⟦E25⟧ Clan, working under the enemy of the Township and Kingdom, ⟦E27⟧. By mandate of ⟦E14⟧, this vile betrayer of ⟦E10⟧ is wanted dead. Show his paw to the Magistrate as proof of his death.
rows.quest:180:progress:0: What news do you bring before the Court?
rows.quest:180:completion:0: So the evil ⟦E23⟧ is dead? Good riddance to that foul creature. You are very brave, ⟦9⟧. The Township of Lakeshire thanks you for your aid.
rows.quest:249:obj:1: Bring his ⟦E28⟧ to ⟦E29⟧ at the Tower of Azora in ⟦E30⟧.
rows.quest:249:details:0: After much observation, I have discovered ⟦E27⟧'s plans.
rows.quest:249:details:1: He searches for the Scythe of ⟦E31⟧...and he may have found it! If he has, then the ⟦E32⟧, and the kingdom of ⟦E10⟧, will soon feel his dark might.
rows.quest:249:details:2: I am not prepared to pit myself against ⟦E27⟧, but I fear he must be dealt with now. So you must enter the Tower of Ilgalar and face ⟦E27⟧.
rows.quest:249:details:3: Defeat him, and bring me his ⟦E28⟧. Do this, and the kingdom will owe you much.
rows.quest:249:progress:0: Hurry, ⟦10⟧, before my fears of ⟦E27⟧ spreading his power are made real!
rows.quest:249:completion:0: You have done well, ⟦11⟧. In defeating the warlock ⟦E27⟧, ⟦E10⟧ is saved from a grave peril.
rows.quest:249:completion:1: I offer you this reward most humbly. And I would bid you peace, if these were peaceful times.
rows.quest:249:completion:2: But instead, I will bid you luck with your trials, and victory in the conflicts ahead.
rows.quest:98247:title: ⟦E34⟧
